sanskrit: सञ्जय उवाच । तं तथा कृपयाविष्टम् अश्रुपूर्णाकुलेक्षणम् । विषीदन्तम् इदं वाक्यम् उवाच मधुसूदनः ॥
translation: Sanjaya said: Seeing Arjuna full of compassion and despair, with tearful eyes, Madhusudana spoke the following words.

sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच । कुतस्त्वा कश्मलमिदं विषमे समुपस्थितम् । अनार्यजुष्टमस्वर्ग्यमकीर्तिकरमर्जुन ॥
translation: The Supreme Lord said: From where has this weakness come upon you at this critical hour, O Arjuna? It is unworthy of an honorable man, not conducive to higher planets, and brings disgrace.

sanskrit: क्लैब्यं मा स्म गमः पार्थ नैतत्त्वय्युपपद्यते । क्षुद्रं हृदयदौर्बल्यं त्यक्त्वोत्तिष्ठ परन्तप ॥
translation: Do not yield to unmanliness, O Partha. It does not befit you. Give up this petty weakness of heart and arise, O vanquisher of foes.

sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच । कथं भीष्ममहं सङ्ख्ये द्रोणं च मधुसूदन । इषुभिः प्रतियोत्स्यामि पूजार्हावरिसूदन ॥
translation: Arjuna said: O Madhusudana, how shall I fight with arrows in battle against Bhishma and Drona, who are worthy of worship, O destroyer of enemies?

sanskrit: गुरूनहत्वा हि महानुभावान् श्रेयो भोक्तुं भैक्ष्यमपीह लोके । हत्वार्थकामांस्तु गुरूनिहैव भुञ्जीय भोगान् रुधिरप्रदिग्धान् ॥
translation: It is better in this world to live on alms without slaying these great souls who are my teachers. But if I kill them, even though they are desirous of wealth, I would enjoy pleasures tainted with blood.

sanskrit: न चैतद्विद्मः कतरन्नो गरीयो यद्वा जयेम यदि वा नो जयेयुः । यानेव हत्वा न जिजीविषामस्तेऽवस्थिताः प्रमुखे धार्तराष्ट्राः ॥
translation: Nor do we know which is better for us—to conquer them or be conquered by them. The sons of Dhritarashtra, whom we would not wish to kill, now stand before us in battle.

sanskrit: कार्पण्यदोषोपहतस्वभावः पृच्छामि त्वां धर्मसम्मूढचेताः । यच्छ्रेयः स्यान्निश्चितं ब्रूहि तन्मे शिष्यस्तेऽहं शाधि मां त्वां प्रपन्नम् ॥
translation: My nature is overcome by weakness and my mind is confused about duty. I ask You to tell me clearly what is best for me. I am Your disciple and surrender to You. Please instruct me.

sanskrit: न हि प्रपश्यामि ममापनुद्याद् यच्छोकम् उच्छोषणम् इन्द्रियाणाम् । अवाप्य भूमावसपत्नमृद्धं राज्यं सुराणामपि चाधिपत्यम् ॥
translation: I do not see how any means will remove the sorrow that is drying up my senses, even if I obtain an unrivaled kingdom on earth or sovereignty like the gods in heaven.

sanskrit: सञ्जय उवाच । एवमुक्त्वा हृषीकेशं गुडाकेशः परन्तप । न योत्स्य इति गोविन्दम् उक्त्वा तूष्णीं बभूव ह ॥
translation: Sanjaya said: Having spoken thus to Hrishikesha, Arjuna, the conqueror of enemies, said he would not fight and became silent.

sanskrit: तमुवाच हृषीकेशः प्रहसन्निव भारत । सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये विषीदन्तमिदं वचः ॥
translation: O Bharata, Hrishikesha, smiling as if in jest, spoke these words to the grief-stricken Arjuna in the midst of the two armies.
